note: Safety guidance is based on Philippine maritime, public-health, and local disaster-risk guidance. Always follow current instructions from ferry operators, local authorities, and official weather advisories.
seaTravel: Know the trip schedule, buy a ticket early when possible, and arrive at the port early.
Use registered/authorized passenger vessels and follow port and crew instructions.
Follow the vessel's life-jacket instructions and wear or keep it ready as directed by the crew.
Do not board an overcrowded vessel or a trip that exceeds its authorized passenger capacity.
Make sure your ticket and passenger-manifest details are correct before boarding.
Do not rely only on Saferry. Follow current operator, port, Coast Guard, and weather advisories.
beachSafety: Use designated or monitored swimming areas and check warning signs and local safety notices.
Prefer beaches with lifeguards and readily available life-saving equipment.
Do not swim alone; adults should accompany children and vulnerable swimmers.
Stay away from marked danger areas and zones used by anchored or moving watercraft.
Avoid swimming when drunk or otherwise unable to respond safely to changing conditions.
Keep 911 and relevant local emergency contacts accessible before entering the water.
